qpitt.l: Temperature under 36 degrees C. HYPOTHERMIA ONLY. Fever scores nothing at all on this score, however high.
Systolic blood pressure under 90 mmHg, or vasopressors in use. Some reproductions print "90 or below"; the derivation reads below 90, which is what is applied.
Respiratory rate of 25 or more, or mechanical ventilation. Worth exactly as much as cardiac arrest on this score.
Altered mental status. Binary. The predecessor graded it.
Cardiac arrest. Worth 1 here; worth 4 on the predecessor.
